items.name: REPLYGO
items.description: ReplyGo turns a single bio link into a mini storefront for creators, affiliates, and small sellers: business profile, product catalog, Xendit QRIS checkout, shipping checks, dynamic QR codes, and branded invoices, plus an AI assistant that helps followers find products and get answers before checkout.

items.name: CHATRIGO
items.description: Multi-tenant B2B omnichannel chatbot SaaS unifying WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, LINE, and web chat into per-tenant workspaces, with Xendit QRIS billing, conversation summaries, and tenant RBAC. Designed the RAG orchestration layer and an AI sales agent with evidence-bound product recommendations, scoping every query by tenant. Led architecture and code review for a team of 8 interns.

items.name: CHATRIGO MOBILE
items.description: Companion mobile app for the Chatrigo omnichannel platform — lets teams stay on top of customer conversations and agent workflows on the go, connected to the same SaaS backend as the web product.

items.name: E-SIGN

items.details: Lead architecture, code review, and SDLC standards for a team of 8 interns, 4 of them directly managed. Architected Chatrigo, a multi-tenant omnichannel chatbot platform unifying WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, LINE, and web chat, used by 10 business users across client organizations. Built ReplyGo, a link-in-bio storefront with a Rust/Axum backend and an AI assistant. Designed the RAG orchestration layer that grounds responses in each tenant's knowledge base and scopes every query by tenant.

Shipped three municipal systems into production during a five-month internship; all remain live today. Built an e-signature platform (Laravel) deployed for school document signing across Balikpapan's 278 primary and junior-secondary schools, a personnel management application for salary review and promotion (KGB) requests, and a Flutter web and mobile public-service application (E-Manuntung).
Built and maintained the UNITY UMN English competition site in parallel with the Diskominfo internship; owned event registration and content-publishing flows.

Taught Machine Learning, Algorithms & Data Structures, Web Programming, Mobile Application Programming, and Introduction to Internet Technology. Mentored and evaluated 200+ students across laboratory sessions and authored exam materials used for official university assessment.
